description: His basket was the errand. He was not in the parlour.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Named on the tables. Not in the room.
name: Edith Kettlewood

description: Named Lady Day and kept the coin out of the parlour.
name: John Heminges

description: Told them to pay her, gave the prince his line, and took the late laugh.
name: Will Kemp

description: Kept the line, and did not strike it.
name: William Shakespeare
